# govault_pki_bundle (Data Source)

Read the public CA certificates of a GoVault namespace (PEM). Public data: it holds certificates only, never a key, and is read from the unauthenticated public PKI routes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Public CA certificates of a namespace (intermediate and root).
data "govault_pki_bundle" "team_a" {
  namespace = "team-a"
}

# Public certificate of one intermediate CA.
data "govault_pki_bundle" "issuer" {
  namespace = "team-a"
  issuer    = "gv.pki.ca.0000000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer` (String) Id of one intermediate CA (gv.pki.ca.<id>); omit for the namespace bundle (active intermediate and root).
- `namespace` (String) GoVault namespace; defaults to the namespace of the authenticated session.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The namespace (session when it is defaulted), followed by /issuer when an issuer is given.
- `pem` (String) CA certificate(s), PEM.
